train_ranker_model: train a BERT-based reranking model on a dataset with gradient accumulation and evaluation
predict_ranker_accuracy: run inference on a reranking model and compute hit-at-one accuracy over a dataset
load_saved_checkpoint: load a saved model checkpoint into a RankModel with key name filtering
create_ranking_dataset: create a RankingDataset from a JSON file with tokenization and max sequence length constraints
configure_optimizer: configure an AdamW optimizer with weight decay exclusion for bias and LayerNorm parameters
